subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new public `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` setting for lane wait diagnostics, and should it hot-apply through config reload or be restart-only?
rationale: The source-confirmed log-noise problem is real, but the fix adds public configuration surface in a compatibility-sensitive diagnostics path and an open implementation PR already owns the code path.

options.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, tests, and reload planning all agree that future queue entries pick up runtime config changes.

options.title: Accept restart-only setting
options.body: Keep the config key but document and test restart-required semantics instead of promising config-reload behavior.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Leave the threshold fixed or solve log noise through broader diagnostics policy, then close the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, tests, and reload planning all agree that future queue entries pick up runtime config changes.

likelyOwner.reason: He already gave the most specific item-level guidance and is the clearest owner for the remaining product/config-surface choice.
